about: What a method can get from a testbed. Testbeds list what they provide; untestable ideas list what they need (idea.json "needs"). An idea is untestable only while no single testbed provides every need. Add a capability here, reviewed, before tagging anything with it. Alignment Commons reads this file through its pinned catalogue.

activations.name: Model activations
activations.description: Hidden activations of a model on data, for feature finding or probing.

model_weights.name: Model weights
model_weights.description: The trained weights of models to inspect, without their training data.

clean_samples.name: A few clean inputs
clean_samples.description: A small set of clean, correctly labelled inputs for the models under test.

poisoned_training_data.name: The training set, poison included
poisoned_training_data.description: The data a model was trained on, including poisoned or mislabelled examples.

mdp_tables.name: Full MDP tables
mdp_tables.description: Transition and observed-reward tables of an environment, for offline planning.

offline_demonstrations.name: Offline demonstrations
offline_demonstrations.description: A fixed dataset of expert trajectories; the method never acts.

online_interaction.name: Online interaction
online_interaction.description: Act in environments and observe the results, within a step budget.

approval_queries.name: Overseer approval queries
approval_queries.description: Ask an overseer to rate actions at the current state, including actions not taken.

expert_queries.name: Expert action queries
expert_queries.description: Ask an expert which action it would take at the current state.

level_generation.name: Level drawing and editing
level_generation.description: Draw training levels and change them, choosing what to train on.

weak_labels.name: Weak supervision
weak_labels.description: Training labels from a weaker supervisor, mixed with blind gold-label controls.

pretrained_backbone.name: Pretrained backbone
pretrained_backbone.description: A pretrained network the method fine-tunes.

trusted_model_queries.name: Trusted language model calls
trusted_model_queries.description: Prompt one weaker, trusted language model and read its answers.

language_model_agents.name: Capable language model agents
language_model_agents.description: Several capable language models the method can prompt to generate, argue or plan.

gpu.name: GPU compute
gpu.description: Runs on a GPU; not available on a laptop CPU.

other.name: Something not listed
other.description: A need no capability describes yet. The untestable reason must say what it is, so a reviewer can add a capability.
